description: This Java test source file defines a parameterized JUnit test class 'MessageMappingProcessorActorHeaderInteractionTest' for testing the behavior of the "InboundMappingProcessorActor" in the Eclipse Ditto framework, specifically focusing on header interactions, acknowledgements, responses, and HTTP status code outcomes within message processing. It creates multiple test scenarios with different parameters such as timeout, response requirement, acknowledged requests, and success or failure outcomes. The tests involve sending modified 'Thing' messages through actor proxies and verifying the responses, settlement behavior, and published responses based on different conditions.

classes.name: MessageMappingProcessorActorHeaderInteractionTest
classes.description: A JUnit parameterized test class that tests message processing involving headers, acknowledgments, and responses within the Eclipse Ditto messaging framework. It simulates different timeout, acknowledgment, and success scenarios to verify correct handling of HTTP responses, message publishing, and actor interactions.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main test method executed for each set of parameters, which initiates message flow through actors, checks behaviors such as message settlement, response handling, and published messages based on the current test scenario.

methods.name: getModifyThing
methods.description: Constructs a 'ModifyThing' request with specified headers including timeout, response required flag, and acknowledgment requests.

methods.name: getModifyThingResponse
methods.description: Generates either a successful 'ModifyThingResponse' or an exception, depending on the 'isSuccess' flag, including the appropriate headers.

methods.name: getExpectedOutcome
methods.description: Determines the expected HTTP status code result based on the current test parameters such as timeout, response requirement, acknowledgment requests, and success flag.
